{{Top|leg}}
'''House Comprassi''' was one of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]] circa [[3660 BBY]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] conquered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] in an attempt to strike back against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]]. [[House Palerma]], another house of Serenno, had allied itself with the Jedi, with Zallow using their villa as his headquarters. The Sith, under the command of [[Darth Malgus]], succeeded in their attack, and took control of the world. House Comprassi, however, did not sit idly by, and along with [[House Teramo]] hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to strike back against the Sith. The attack was a failure, as [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] cut down the attackers in the dark, [[Death/Legends|killing]] them all.
